title: Round 12's checkpoints on every validation family: an evaluation of a stage, not the gate
description: Round 12 (exp-net2-r12-mix-147: recurrent PPO from the reward on net1 v5, the flow alone on about half the training links, competing on 40%) is the first PPO round whose training evaluation reached and held the rule's level on every condition of the new family for some checkpoints: the rule arm at iteration 59 (seeds 1 to 3: -0.029, +0.030, +0.017) and 79 (+0.000, +0.014, +0.018). This runs those two checkpoints, each as one candidate over its three seeds (release model-net2-r12-cands), next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, campaign seed 21, with the share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 as a reference; experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py scores it. It is evidence for choosing the next stage, not the gate: the checkpoints were picked on the new family's validation links, which this report reuses, and the gate runs after a line's last stage.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
